{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the distribution of customer_age
table_age = sales['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index()
print(table_age)

# Check for the -1 values
missing_age_count = (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {missing_age_count}")

# Check the revenue column
print("\nFirst few revenue values:")
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for the 999999.99 values
fraudulent_revenue_count = (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
print(f"Number of 999999.99 revenue entries: {fraudulent_revenue_count}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Check for channel imbalance
channel_segment_cross = pd.crosstab(sales['channel'], sales['customer_segment'])
print("\nChannel vs Customer Segment:")
print(channel_segment_cross)"}
